We'll work out the indefinite integral first, and then proceed to work out the definite integral.

In this case, we define

$$
\begin{aligned}u=(\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x))^{2} & \,⟹\,\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=\frac{2\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x)}{x}\,, \\ \frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}=243{x}^{2} & \,⟹\,v=\int \frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x=\int 243{x}^{2}\,\text{d}x=81{x}^{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

Using the formula of integration by parts, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\int 243{x}^{2}(\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x))^{2}\,\text{d}x & =\int u\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =uv-\int v\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x \\  & ={(\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x))}^{2}(81{x}^{3})-\int (81{x}^{3})(\frac{2\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x)}{x})\,\text{d}x \\  & =81{x}^{3}{(\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x))}^{2}-162\int {x}^{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x)\,\text{d}x.\end{aligned}
$$

We use integration by parts once again to evaluate $\int {x}^{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x)\,\text{d}x.$ We take

$$
\begin{aligned}u=\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x) & \,⟹\,\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=\frac{1}{x}\,, \\ \frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}={x}^{2} & \,⟹\,v=\int \frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x=\int {x}^{2}\,\text{d}x=\frac{{x}^{3}}{3}\,.\end{aligned}
$$

In this case, the formula for integration by parts gives

$$
\begin{aligned}\int {x}^{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x)\,\text{d}x & =\int u\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =uv-\int v\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x)(\frac{{x}^{3}}{3})-\int (\frac{{x}^{3}}{3})(\frac{1}{x})\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{{x}^{3}\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x)}{3}-\frac{1}{3}\int {x}^{2}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\frac{{x}^{3}\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x)}{3}-\frac{{x}^{3}}{9}+D,\end{aligned}
$$

where $D$ is an integral constant. 

So, we get that the indefinite integral is

$$
\begin{aligned}\int 243{x}^{2}(\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x))^{2}\,\text{d}x & =81{x}^{3}{(\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x))}^{2}-162\int {x}^{2}\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x)\,\text{d}x \\  & =81{x}^{3}{(\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x))}^{2}-162(\frac{{x}^{3}\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x)}{3}-\frac{{x}^{3}}{9}+D) \\  & =81{x}^{3}{(\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x))}^{2}-54{x}^{3}\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x)+18{x}^{3}-162D \\  & ={x}^{3}(81{(\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x))}^{2}-54\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x)+18)+C,\end{aligned}
$$

where $C=-162D.$

Finally, we can work out the definite integral:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{1/3}^{e/3}243{x}^{2}(\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x))^{2}\text{d}x & ={[{x}^{3}(81{(\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x))}^{2}-54\operatorname{ln}⁡(3x)+18)]}_{1/3}^{e/3} \\  & =[{(\frac{e}{3})}^{3}(81{(\operatorname{ln}⁡(3\cdot \frac{e}{3}))}^{2}-54\operatorname{ln}⁡(3\cdot \frac{e}{3})+18)] \\  & \,-[{(\frac{1}{3})}^{3}(81{(\operatorname{ln}⁡(3\cdot \frac{1}{3}))}^{2}-54\operatorname{ln}⁡(3\cdot \frac{1}{3})+18)] \\  & =[\frac{{e}^{3}}{27}(81{(\operatorname{ln}⁡e)}^{2}-54\operatorname{ln}⁡e+18)]-[\frac{1}{27}(81{(\operatorname{ln}⁡1)}^{2}-54\operatorname{ln}⁡1+18)] \\  & =[\frac{{e}^{3}}{27}(81-54+18)]-\frac{1}{27}\cdot 18 \\  & =\frac{5{e}^{3}-2}{3}\end{aligned}
$$
